description_en: Unsubscribes from the detailed bill export service
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi unsubscribe-bill-to-oss --subscribe-type BillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod --mult-account-rel-subscribe MA --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnsubscribeBillToOSS

parameters.description_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:

- BillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod: detailed bills of billable items.

- InstanceDetailForBillingPeriod: detailed bills of instances.

- BillingItemDetailMonthly: monthly summary of bills by billable item.

- InstanceDetailMonthly: monthly summary of bills by instance.

- SplitItemDetailDaily: daily summary of split bills.

- MonthBill: monthly bills in PDF format. You can only subscribe to the bills of the Alibaba Cloud account.
parameters.description_zh:
订阅类型。取值类型：

- BillingItemDetailMonthly：计费项消费账期汇总。
- InstanceDetailMonthly：实例消费账期汇总。
- SplitItemDetailDaily: 分账账单按天汇总。
- MonthBill：月账单PDF。仅支持订阅MA。

parameters.name: subscribe_type

parameters.description_en:
The type of bill to push for a multi-level account. Valid values:

- MA: pushes the bills of the Alibaba Cloud account.

- ACP1: pushes the bills of a reseller's sub-account.

Default value: MA.
parameters.description_zh:
对于多级账号，可指定推送账单的类型。可选值为：


- MA：推送主账号账单。
- ACP1：推送虚商子账号账单。

默认值：MA。
